desc: Orlivane dog suspender boots connect four soft boots with adjustable straps to a neck strap, which helps keep the boots on during walks. Each boot has a hook-and-loop strap, a water-resistant fabric upper and a textured anti-slip sole. Sizes S to XL; please check the size chart (neck, leg length, paw width, leg span, back length) before ordering. Colors: black and red.
b: SUSPENDER DESIGN — Four boots are joined by adjustable straps that run up the legs and along the back to a neck strap, so the boots are held in place while your dog walks and runs.

ADJUSTABLE FIT — Slide buckles on every strap and a hook-and-loop strap on each boot let you adjust the fit for different body shapes. The quick-release neck buckle can also be connected to your dog's collar.
KEEP PAWS CLEAN — A water-resistant fabric upper and a textured anti-slip sole help keep mud, rain and dirt off the paws on daily walks, so less mess comes back into the house.
4 SIZES — S, M, L, XL. Measure neck, leg length, paw width, leg span and back length, then check the size chart in the images before ordering (manual measurement, allow slight deviation).
WHAT YOU GET — One set with 4 boots and the connected strap harness, in black or red. About 110 g (S) to 140 g (XL).
